calcul-vectorial/ui.Lecție interactivă de fizică: mărimi vec: Interactive physics lesson: vector quantities, components, addition, subtraction, scalar multiplication, decomposition, dot product, cross product and scalar triple product.

miscarea-rectilinie/ui.Formula pentru distanța de oprire este s: The stopping-distance formula is written for v₀ > 0 and a < 0. In the general case, −v₀²/(2a) is the signed displacement to the stop; distance travelled remains positive.
miscarea-rectilinie/ui.Traiectoria este o elipsă. Planetele se: The path is an ellipse. Planets move on ellipses around the Sun (Kepler’s laws). The animation illustrates the path shape; it does not calculate Keplerian orbital motion.
